tasks.short: Observe patients, chart and report condition changes and take necessary action.

steps.what: Observe the actual patient and check condition changes, including possible adverse medication or treatment reactions
Assess the observed change and take necessary immediate nursing action within existing instructions and scope
inputs: current care instructions and escalation procedure
outputs: actual nursing response and continuing concerns

steps.what: Prepare the actual condition-change report with patient identity, observations, time, response and unresolved concern
inputs: actual nursing response and continuing concerns
outputs: complete condition-change report and intended internal clinician recipient

steps.what: Confirm the actual report facts, identity and exact receiving clinician immediately before reporting
inputs: complete condition-change report and intended internal clinician recipient

steps.what: Report the approved actual condition change directly to the internal responsible nurse or clinician and clarify their response
Prepare the actual patient chart entry with observations, action, report time and actual clinician response
inputs: actual nursing response and continuing concerns

steps.what: Review and approve the finished actual chart entry against patient identity, events and record destination
Commit the approved actual condition-change entry to the internal patient chart

tasks.design: Configure native actual-event fields and approved note layouts in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record. Physical observation, response and direct clinician reporting remain human. The report is prepared and fact-confirmed immediately before direct handover, whose actual response is then captured in the chart draft. Native fields reduce repeated patient/context copying, not observation. Final chart approval precedes a separate record commit. Any changed facts void approval. No model, autonomous clinical decision or delayed emergency action is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual observations, handover and actions are repeatedly entered into chart sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient-context fields and actual-event chart templates.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing deterioration and responding to the actual patient.
tasks.human_edge: Notice and act on a change that does not fit the routine.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated chart handling around current nursing care.

tasks.altitude: Patient observation and action remain accountable nursing work.

reach.learn: Distinguish actual observations and responses from planned care.

evidence.claim: Electronic patient record templates can reuse patient context while nurses enter and approve actual events.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not observed. Immediate care and urgent verbal escalation proceed under existing clinical practice; preparation and confirmation describe the nurse's current factual handover, not a new administrative delay.

s1 captures actual observations; s3 manually identifies patient, time, change and action. s6 enters actual clinician response, event times, observed condition and action status; planned instructions are never recorded as performed care.
Vital-sign acquisition and medication administration belong to their specific tasks; if one event combines them with condition monitoring, its observation and charting must be allocated once.
Receiving clinician work is existing downstream care, with no saving credited or additional work transferred by this configuration.
unknowns: Current chart template duplication and actual review burden.
research_questions: Does native actual-event entry reduce time after checking identity and event fidelity?

already_counted.description: Actual chart preparation and final chart review.

approvals.approved_version: current actual condition report, patient identity and named internal clinician; changed facts require renewed confirmation
finished actual condition-change chart entry and exact patient chart destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:4.5 condition-change chart-preparation hours saved less one upkeep. Low: existing native charting removes all new benefit. Same-patient-chart commitment, observation, necessary action and handover retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure and record patients' vital signs.

steps.what: Confirm the patient, requested vital signs and suitable equipment and conditions
Actually measure height, weight, temperature, blood pressure, pulse or respiration and check measurement validity
Prepare the actual vital-sign chart record with value, unit, time, measurement context and patient association
Approve the final actual values, units, measurement time, context and exact patient chart
Commit the approved actual vital signs to the internal patient chart

tasks.design: Configure the native observation chart in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record and existing measuring devices. The nurse identifies the patient and performs every actual measurement. Structured actual-value fields and patient context reduce repeated navigation and headings; there is no assumed new device interface or free data capture. The nurse reviews the completed record before a distinct gated chart commit. Changes void approval. No model or automatic clinical interpretation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurements are repeatedly associated with context and chart fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured observation forms in the existing patient record.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate physical measurement and noticing an implausible result.
tasks.human_edge: Check the actual patient and measurement conditions.

ambition.what: Reduce chart preparation around actual vital-sign measurement.

reach.learn: Use actual measurement time and context, not scheduled time.

evidence.claim: Electronic observation charts can use structured value, unit and time fields with patient context.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. s2 retains full patient preparation and actual measurement effort. s3 includes manually entering each actual value, unit, time and context and confirming the patient; no device import is assumed.
Missing or invalid observations remain missing and require human resolution, not imputation. Any required escalation belongs to actual condition-change care and must be separately counted.
When measurements form part of task 507 or medication monitoring, the same measurement and chart entry must be allocated once in a roll-up.
unknowns: Actual chart navigation and device interface coverage.
research_questions: How much repeated entry remains after actual-value capture and final checks?

already_counted.description: Actual measurement entry and final record review.

approvals.approved_version: exact actual vital-sign values, units, time, context and patient chart destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: six vital-sign record-preparation hours saved less one upkeep. Low: existing native entry removes all new benefit. Same-patient-chart commitment and actual measurement retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer prescribed medications or start IV fluids and chart actual times and amounts.

steps.what: Read the current prescription and patient record and verify medication or IV fluid instructions and unresolved discrepancies
inputs: patient identity and current medication record
outputs: checked current administration instructions or unresolved hold

steps.what: Prepare the actual prescribed medication or IV fluid and patient setup within the nurse's existing authorized scope
inputs: checked current administration instructions or unresolved hold
actual medicine or IV fluid and equipment
outputs: actual prepared medication or fluid and intended patient administration

steps.what: Perform the required final bedside check of the actual prepared medication or fluid, patient, prescription and intended administration
inputs: actual prepared medication or fluid and intended patient administration

steps.what: Actually administer the confirmed prescribed medication or start the confirmed IV fluid and observe the immediate response
outputs: actual administration or nonadministration, time, amount and immediate observations

steps.what: Prepare the actual medication chart entry with administered amount and time or actual nonadministration reason
inputs: actual administration or nonadministration, time, amount and immediate observations

steps.what: Review and approve the finished actual administration record against the event and exact patient chart
Commit the approved actual administration event to the internal medication chart

tasks.design: Configure current-order views and actual-administration fields in {OTHER}, the electronic medication administration and patient record system. All preparation, bedside verification, administration and immediate observation stay human. The final physical preparation exists before bedside confirmation and actual administration. Native chart fields reduce context copying; actual times and amounts are captured after the event and separately approved before record commit. Changed preparation, instructions or chart facts void the corresponding confirmation. No model or automated dosing is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Order retrieval and repeated patient and prescription context surround physical medication work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-order views and actual-event administration forms.
tasks.still_hard: Safe bedside administration and resolving discrepancies.
tasks.human_edge: Verify the actual patient, preparation and response.

ambition.what: Reduce record handling around prescribed administration.

tasks.altitude: Medication care remains within existing authorized human practice.

reach.learn: Keep prescribed, prepared and actually administered amounts distinct.

evidence.claim: Native medication record views and actual-administration fields can reuse current order context while retaining bedside checks.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for routine administrations already authorized within local practice. Required additional independent checks must be included at full time in cases where they apply; no reduction to those checks is claimed.
s1 manually verifies actual current order, patient, medicine/fluid, amount, route and timing and resolves missing or conflicting instructions through existing practice.
s5 manually captures actual time, actual amount, route, status and any nonadministration reason. A prescription or planned administration never becomes evidence that administration occurred.
Condition-change monitoring beyond the immediate administration belongs to task 507 and is counted once when combined.
unknowns: Current-order view completeness and local independent-check requirements.
research_questions: Does chart preparation improve after all actual-event and identity checks?

already_counted.description: Full bedside final check and actual chart preparation and review.

incremental.description: Maintain approved medication record field configuration.

approvals.approved_version: actual prepared medication or fluid, current prescription, patient and immediate intended administration; changes require a new bedside check
finished actual administration time, amount, status and exact patient medication chart

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: three order retrieval and4.5 actual administration-chart preparation hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native medication-chart functions remove new benefit. Same-chart commitment, physical administration and checks retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer patients' calls and determine how to assist them.

steps.what: Answer the actual patient's call, confirm identity and listen to the request and immediate concern
outputs: actual patient identity, request and observed urgency

steps.what: Look up the current care context and approved assistance or escalation instructions for the actual request
inputs: actual patient identity, request and observed urgency
existing care record and approved procedures
outputs: checked relevant care and assistance references

steps.what: Determine how to assist the actual patient and whether immediate human escalation is required
inputs: actual patient identity, request and observed urgency
checked relevant care and assistance references

steps.what: Provide actual assistance and explanation or make an immediate direct clinical escalation when needed
outputs: actual assistance, patient response and outstanding follow-up

steps.what: Prepare any nonurgent internal follow-up message from the actual request, assistance and remaining need
inputs: actual assistance, patient response and outstanding follow-up
outputs: complete nonurgent internal follow-up message and recipient

steps.what: Approve the finished nonurgent follow-up message, actual facts and exact internal recipient
inputs: complete nonurgent internal follow-up message and recipient

steps.what: Send the approved nonurgent follow-up to the named internal care team recipient
Prepare the actual patient call note with request, assistance, response and follow-up status
inputs: actual assistance, patient response and outstanding follow-up

steps.what: Approve the final actual patient call note and exact patient chart destination
Commit the approved actual call note to the internal patient chart

tasks.design: Configure native care-context and approved instruction links in {OTHER}, the patient record and nurse-call system; {DOCS} supplies controlled procedures. Answering, assessing and assisting stay human, including any urgent direct escalation. Only nonurgent follow-up uses {CHAT}, the existing secure internal care messenger: prepare actual message, approve its final version, then send. Actual call-note capture has its own final approval and commit after assistance. Changes void approval. No patient chatbot, automated triage or inferred care completion is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current instructions and handling nonurgent follow-up and notes adds administration around patient calls.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient-context links and approved secure messaging and chart workflows.
tasks.human_edge: Hear what the patient needs and respond in person.

ambition.what: Reduce reference and filing effort around current patient calls.

tasks.altitude: Patient assistance remains human nursing work.

reach.learn: Nonurgent messages supplement direct urgent escalation.

evidence.claim: Native care-record links and secure internal messaging can support human patient-call handling.

assumptions: Shares are provisional across calls, including those needing no follow-up; send-related time is an aggregate, not a requirement to message after every call.
s1 captures actual identity, request and urgency; s2 includes manual reference lookup when patient links are missing. No structured intake is supplied for free.
s5 manually captures actual need, action, outstanding work and recipient. s8 manually captures actual assistance and follow-up status; a sent request is not completed care.
Urgent direct escalation stays within the full human assistance time. Detailed clinical condition-change charting belongs to task 507 when applicable and must not be counted twice.
unknowns: Actual call mix and native reference coverage.
research_questions: Does nonurgent handling improve after all actual capture and review time?

already_counted.description: Actual nonurgent follow-up and call-note capture and final reviews.

incremental.description: Maintain approved reference links and follow-up routing.

approvals.approved_version: complete nonurgent follow-up message, actual patient facts and exact internal recipient
finished actual call note and exact patient chart destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four reference and three actual nonurgent-send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native references and messaging remove new benefit. Same-chart commitment, patient conversation, assessment and assistance retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Direct nursing care with native actual-event records and controlled internal follow-up.
reach: Registered nurses and care colleagues receive actual observations, events and needs.
skills_to_grow: Separating urgent human escalation from nonurgent messaging
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated record handling while retaining patient contact, physical care and clinical judgement.
